_about: Product settings read by the shared tools (core/tools/product.py). Data only: change values here, never in tool code. disclaimer = the bible's ad disclaimer, verbatim. PT-141 comes in TWO forms (nasal spray, sublingual tablet): 'forms' lists each; 'renders' is the default pair the video end card uses when copy.json doesn't name a form.
name: PT-141

spray.label: nasal spray
spray.bottle_wording: clear glass nasal spray bottle with a white atomiser cap and a long white nozzle; bright cyan-blue label with the vertical white EVERLIFE wordmark, a white 'Rx' box top right, a white band reading 'PT-141', small text 'PRESCRIPTION PT-141 MEDICATION', '10ML'

sublingual.label: sublingual tablet
sublingual.bottle_wording: deep navy pill bottle with a black cap and a thin cyan ring; label reads EVERLIFE, 'PT 141' large in white and cyan, a small star, '2MG SUBLINGUAL TABLETS', 'ON-DEMAND INTIMACY SUPPORT FOR MEN & WOMEN', '8 SUBLINGUAL TABLETS', 'PRESCRIPTION USE ONLY'

disclaimer: AI-generated depictions and simulated portrayals used for illustrative advertising purposes. Not actual patients or medical providers. Disclaimer: Individual results may vary. Doctor-prescribed compounded prescription.

hero.element: the nasal spray bottle OR the sublingual tablet, whichever form the ad is for (one form per ad)
hero.label: wraps the curved surface in perspective
hero.never: the other form in the same ad, needles, beds or bedroom scenes
hero._about: creative-system §3: the form's hero element, its minimum canvas width, how its label renders, and what never appears with it

_variations_about: Named exceptions this product opts into; defined in core/references/variations/ (see core/references/ENGINE.md). Everything else is global.
